PASS-WITH-NOTES — final performance/299 at1906566bc2f60e992af1d7e1c292a426f494df8a, answering01a1fa9f-46a4-7851-b754-e89e17a521bc. Final C34 round; keep holding until merge. No new material performance finding.

Linux cost removal verified from final source/diff: production Holders::read()->read_on(actualOS) returns Unknown immediately on linux, before any holder read. The process/fd census, UID classification, proc table parser and fake-proc seam are deleted. Zero proc/fd/table enumeration, holder processes or per-process/FD allocations remain. This is the prime-approved fail-closed platform decision, not a purported complete census. The CLI still read_dirs/sorts the target directory O(NlogN), lstats each fixture-prefixed candidate and reports counts before BLOCKED/exit2; unknown locks return before open/flock and no candidate is removed. Thus holder acquisition is constant work, but the entire Linux command is not O(1). No Linux timing claim or benchmark; reviewer owns the native leader-exit/handoff remove0 runtime proofs.

F247 and new UID guard exercised at this exact head: `nice -n 19 node /tmp/p299-r2-launch-probe.mjs`, exit0; raw /tmp/p299-r2-launch-receipt.json. Actual extracted recipe and actual installer in owned scratch HOME/bin, with isolated release/npm/tmux/port-lsof/holder boundaries. No-holder/valid-holder id launch counts1/1, correct-u501: zero extra id for holder acquisition. UID=^501 refuses exit1 before any holder lsof, leaving owned old process alive; PIJ_BOUNCE_UNSAFE=1 explicitly proceeds but still launches no holder lsof. All cases retain the installer's common id call. No production build/resource read/daemon signal, no fleet APPLY or live bounce; owned groups/scratch cleaned.

macOS acquisition cost unchanged: one default absolute /usr/sbin/lsof -F pn, LC_ALL=C, reader thread and20ms in-process child checks, kill at9s of configured10s, bounded remaining output/reap wait. Strict stat-or-Unknown behavior remains. Escaping error/sample paths adds O(bytes) formatting, no launches or loops. Parsing, filesystem metadata, directory/report work remain outside the launched-read clock; no whole-sweep deadline asserted. Snapshot/SCM_RIGHTS limitations remain disclosed correctness residuals rather than a cost guarantee.

Bounce's nonnumeric-UID case is a shell builtin: adds no id, lsof, sleep or other launch; valid path inherits one default absolute holder lsof. Existing bounded helper still launches absolute /bin/sleep0.1 nominal10/s per active manual wait (holder configured5+2, setter2+2), not per daemon tick or live seat; no new polling site here. In-shell matching remains outside the launched-read bound. No production daemon loop/timer/task/launch-site or spawn_sites inventory change. No extra fleet launch/CPU/RSS window for zero structural daemon steady-state delta.

Evidence provenance: read /tmp/f248-r2-receipts.md and full /tmp/f248-checks3.log JSON (15sensorspass). Coder supplies exact-head association; envelope has no embedded SHA. CI44809868627/5of5 is requester/coder supplied, not rerun. ML1/MU1, UIDRED3.07s and13bounceGREEN50.12s are retained coder summaries. MJ1 was caught in R1 and explicitly not rerun in R2; our exact-head differential/guard smoke is fresh independent proof. R1's1.87s blocked macOS dry run at5e8602e2 is inherited acquisition evidence only, not a final-head benchmark, component attribution or Linux timing. Reviewer native Linux/macOS destructive proofs and security escaping/UID clearance remain independent gates; no duplicate builds or suites by performance.

Destructive semantics: unconditional Linux Unknown is a brake—removing the refusal can only permit more deletion. The prior Linux ownership-filter policy and its incomplete census are gone. macOS holder/type/ownership/lock predicates remain its policy; strict uncertainty and young-mtime checks only spare. This cost clearance is not fleet APPLY authorization, a complete/atomic macOS holder-census claim, or permission to restart the unrelated unresolved-path holder. No new issue requiring a third round; any final-round discovery goes to pm-001 under C34.

magicWand: retain explicit platform refusal proof alongside operation-count receipts so deleting an unsafe census cannot be described as a successful fast census.
difficulties: fail-closed is not free—the candidate sort/stat/report still runs. Whole-command latency must stay separate from launched-read budgets and common installer id launches from the changed holder path. Evidence ledger /tmp/performance-299-final-static-cost.json. Keep performance/299 until merge.
